A 10-minute in-Foundry smoke test that exercises every activity on all five actors (plus both magic items) by actually rolling them. If every box checks out, the compendium data is behaving exactly as documented — no JSON reading required.

Setup (1 minute): import the five actors from the New Ragnarok Reborn — NPCs compendium into a blank scene, drag the loot items from the Treasures pack onto any player token, and enable GM eye so you can see every chat card.

How to read the table: each row is one click on an actor sheet. The Should show column is what the chat card must display. Any mismatch — wrong bonus, wrong dice, missing effect, empty recharge — is a data bug: note it and compare against the release's check-actor-fixes.py output before reporting. The Runbook column links straight to the matching page of the encounter runbook, so a failed roll lands on the GM guidance for that ability.

Budget: 3 min for the Ewoks, 4 min for Umbrathor, 3 min for Vorath. Empty checkbox = untested. This checklist is generated from the actor data — a new activity on any actor appears here automatically after python3 tools/gen-playtest.py.

11Ewokling — Evasive Tumble (1/Day) — TumbleTumbleno roll — disengage-style reposition

Surge riders — a failed save applies one random effect for 1 minute; roll it three times if you can spare the clicks:

  • Laughter — target gains incapacitated (status icon visible)
  • Fear of Technology — no icon; refusal flavor only (state it aloud)
  • Battle Fury — attack rolls improve by 2, AC reduced by 2 while active

Recharge chips: Surge recharges on 5–6, Spark on 6 — verify the little die badge on the item appears after a short-rest recovery or a manual recharge.

Dark Bolt on-hit: a hit should apply Max HP Reduced to the target (effect appears on the victim's sheet; hp.max drops). Check that target after the hit.

Lair actions: enable the lair from the Lair Actions (Shadow Cavern) item (initiative 20), or just roll each activity manually from the item — manual rolls are enough for this checklist.

Spell DCs are flat 20 — every save Vorath forces shows DC 20 in the chat card regardless of his abilities. If a card shows a computed DC, that's the pre-1.3.2 bug: re-import the actor.

Legendary actions appear under the actor's legendary actions bar; the two legendary items can also be rolled directly if you don't want to drive the action economy.

Lair actions: enable from Lair Actions (Hellheim Throne Room) (initiative 20) or roll manually as above.

CheckPass condition
ARecharge countersafter Surge/Spark/Dark Burst, the item shows its recharge die (5–6 / 6 / 5–6) and comes back after a rest or manual recharge
BDuration chipsfailed riders (frightened, charmed, paralyzed, restrained, stunned, incapacitated) show status icons and expire after their 1-minute duration
CConcentrationCloudkill's Cast marks Vorath concentrating; a second concentration spell prompts to drop it
DLegendary actionsVorath's legendary action counter is visible and spends on the two legendary items
EAmulet of the Nightdragged item applies its effect to the wearer: melee spell attacks and ranged spell attacks deal an extra 1d6 necrotic — 1d4 on the Level 8 (CR 13) copy, matching its own text
FCloak of Shadowsdragged item applies its effect to the wearer: advantage on Stealth checks (condition: light - dim or darker — toggle the effect on when it applies)
GSummonsevery spawned token (Ewoklings, Shadows, Zombie) has a working sheet with its own attacks — click one attack to confirm
HDeath housekeeping0 HP shows defeated; Dark Pact healing at 0 HP revives him conscious

Verdict: 48/48 activity rows and A–H all checked with zero surprises — the pack is table-ready. Any mismatch: note the row, then run python3 tools/check-actor-fixes.py --verify <exported-actor.json> against the release's snapshot to pinpoint which value drifted, and compare with the changelog to see when it broke.

This checklist is generated from the same data the CI gate asserts — its expected values cannot silently drift from the actors.
